name: Pulsar Vault
description: Local-first PulsarOS notes, Markdown task checklists, code snippets, and vault sync workspace powered by PulsarScript v1.2.
author: PulsarOS & PulsarScript

handlers.name: initVault
handlers.description: Ensure vault folders exist, seed starter notes on first launch, rebuild index, and return workspace snapshot

handlers.name: listNotes
handlers.description: Filter, search, sort, and summarize vault notes with health stats and tag counts

handlers.name: getNote
handlers.description: Read a single note with parsed Markdown tasks and reading metrics

handlers.name: saveNote
handlers.description: Create or update a note atomically, refresh the CoW tag index, and write a Base64 snapshot

handlers.name: toggleTask
handlers.description: Toggle a Markdown task checkbox line inside a note and persist atomically

handlers.name: deleteNote
handlers.description: Delete a note file and prune stale tag index entries

handlers.name: exportBundlePage
handlers.description: Export cursor-paginated Markdown digest, JSON archive, or Base64 backup within RPC budget

handlers.name: getPrefs
handlers.description: Read persisted KV preferences merged with defaults

handlers.name: savePrefs
handlers.description: Merge or reset KV preferences using objMerge and objDelete

handlers.name: injectCorruptSample
handlers.description: Write an intentionally malformed JSON sample note to demonstrate try/catch quarantine

handlers.name: clearCorruptSamples
handlers.description: Clean up quarantined corrupt sample files from the vault

handlers.name: onFsChange
handlers.description: Handle external fs.change events and notify the open Pulsar Vault window
